timingNote: Recording time after the two probes; their exact wall-clock timestamps were not captured.
classification: Isolated loopback HTTP test servers; not Firebase or emulator integration.
method: Loaded committed core with git show and a data-module import. Temporarily replaced node:http.request only in the test process to direct the transport to an ephemeral IPv4 loopback server; restored it afterward.

fragmentedResponse.conclusion: The existing socket inactivity timeout does not enforce a 3000 ms total request deadline.

prematureClose.conclusion: The real native HTTP client already emitted an error for this premature-close case.

limitations: No Windows execution or Windows seed timeout was reproduced.
No defect was found in the examined POST UTF-8 Content-Length and end(payload) framing.
The specific cause of the user's reported Windows timeout remains unconfirmed.
Additional aborted/close handling is defensive hardening, not a demonstrated fix for a real premature-close hang.
